text: You had Ruth suspended. I watched Security walk her back to the lab, and I brought the upload forward. One region's schedule went an hour ago.
style: Senior engineer in his late forties, born in Madrid and twenty years in England. Speak with a consistent light Castilian Spanish accent in fluent British English throughout — do not shift to any other accent. Low, soft pitch; slow, worn pace. Exhausted and grieving, past the point of lying; quietly desperate rather than angry.
